text:
Maya (Product Designer): dropping an alternate roles-grid proposal: dual-column layout so role name + description on left, actions + count on right. aims to improve scan for matrix dense orgs. attach proto link.
Owen (PM): looks promising. my concern is vertical space on small screens. can we collapse description under an affordance?
Diego (Frontend): we could show first 2 lines of description and a "more" chevron. also implement row virtualization for perf.
Priya (A11y): ensure truncated text still has full content in the DOM for screen readers, and that the "more" control is keyboard accessible.
Ruth (DesignOps): add visual token for SSO-enforced roles: a small shield icon with tooltip. also add variant in storybook.
design-bot: Component story created: https://storybook.internal/roles-grid/variant-dualcolumn :robot_face:
Maya (Product Designer): copy for shield tooltip: "SSO enforced: members must authenticate via your identity provider." keep it concise.
Owen (PM): add inline helper: "SSO roles require provisioning via SCIM or invite." helpful for admins.
Diego (Frontend): for the invite flow: replace modal with a slide-over that preserves scroll position. saves context for admins reviewing many roles.
Priya (A11y): slide-over must trap focus and restore it on close. include role name in the heading for announce. also ensure motion reduction respects user prefs.
Ruth (DesignOps): can we add a microcopy audit to ensure consistent verbs across CTAs: "Invite members" vs "Add member" vs "Assign user". I'll lead that.
Maya (Product Designer): small visual tweak: increase contrast on the assigned-count chip to meet 4.5:1.
Diego (Frontend): will update CSS and push colors to tokens. also adding aria-live announcements when invites succeed.
Owen (PM): testing plan: 5 tasks across matrix sizes (5, 50, 500 users). two moderated + 4 unmoderated. focus on discoverability of SSO toggle, invite flow, and audit drawer.
Priya (A11y): include a screen-reader-only checklist in test script and capture keyboard-only completion rates.
Maya (Product Designer): thanks all  i'll iterate the figma and tag the session notes.
